subject: URGENT 60k cups for festival
body:
Hi,

We run the Big Sky Summer Kickoff. We need 60,000 8oz cups with our 3-color logo, delivered to Bozeman, MT by April 5. I heard overseas is the cheapest option so can we get overseas pricing?

I need a firm yes/no TODAY so I can lock in our vendor list.

Tyrell Okafor
Operations Director
needs_human_reason: Order is $6,390+, over $5,000 (rule 1). Delivery by Apr 5 needs a firm date tighter than standard lead times or a rush, and only the owner can confirm a rush (rule 2).
summary: Festival needs 60k 8 oz 3-color cups in Bozeman by Apr 5 and wants a firm yes today. Overseas can't make it. USA standard $6,390 is tight; 2-week rush $7,281 needs owner approval.
draft_reply:
Hi Tyrell,

I can't give you a firm yes on April 5 today, but here's exactly where things stand. Overseas can't make it (10-12 weeks after proof approval). Our USA partner can print your 60,000 3-color cups, and our owner will confirm directly whether we can lock in April 5.

USA partner, standard (3-4 weeks after proof approval)
60,000 x $0.099 ($0.089 + $0.010 for the 3rd color) = $5,940.00
Setup: 3 colors x $150 = $450.00
Freight: free (lower 48)
Total: $6,390.00
With the proof approved by March 9, these ship around March 30 - April 6, before transit, so April 5 is at risk.

USA partner, 2-week rush (may be available, owner must confirm)
Cups: $5,940.00 + 15% rush ($891.00)
Setup: $450.00
Total: $7,281.00
With the proof approved by March 9, a rush would ship around March 23.

To keep April 5 possible, please send your logo as a vector file (AI, EPS, PDF, or SVG) and the Bozeman delivery address today so we can get a proof to you right away. A 50% deposit starts production and the balance is due before shipping. Quotes are estimates, good for 30 days, and don't include sales tax.

The UNIQ Supply Team
assumptions: 'Delivered to Bozeman by April 5' treated as the need-by date.
Bozeman, MT is in the lower 48.
owner_note: Needs a yes/no TODAY. Standard USA ships Mar 30-Apr 6 before transit, so Apr 5 realistically needs the 2-week rush ($7,281 total). Decide on the rush and call him; he's locking his vendor list today.
